provider: single-host Linux sandbox/VM (verified from Caddyfile, supervisor, workflows) — NOT a serverless platform

runtime.web: Next.js (output: standalone in config; dev server -p 3000 via self-healing supervisor)
runtime.port_binding: Caddy :81 reverse_proxy → localhost:3000 (X-Forwarded-* preserved); port 3000 fixed by start scripts
runtime.restart_persistence: scripts/server_supervisor.sh polls port 3000 every 20s and restarts; scripts/start_server.sh one-command restore after recycle

database.engine: SQLite via Prisma (schema.prisma provider=sqlite, DATABASE_URL env)
database.location: db/custom.db on the persistent workspace volume
database.persistence: VERIFIED — file survives process restarts (verified across supervisor restarts and prior sandboxes); additive BetaProfile migration applied with data intact (1,042,969 bars before/after)
database.limitation: single-writer SQLite: fine for this single-process host; a multi-instance deployment would require an external DB — none is authorized

workers.model: Python pipeline (task107 monitor / task108 worker / task110+ phases) under scripts/server_supervisor.sh + GitHub Actions schedules (intraday-poll, daily-psx-pipeline)
workers.singleton: idempotency ledgers + lock files in data/backtest_reports/*/ops; web app never starts duplicate workers
workers.beta_rule: no expensive computation in request paths — /api/beta/insight reads pre-verified DB bars + immutable artifacts only (12-strategy evaluation is O(n) per symbol over ≤400 bars)

cache.redis: REDIS_URL not configured on this host → cache runs in documented DEGRADED mode (explicit status, no silent mock)

external_access: provider egress verified in production (Task 107 ingestion 2026-11-05); Caddy terminates internal proxying
beta_readiness: READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS (degraded cache, single-host scale ceiling, no external Redis)
